Hai Sakhawat Ka Aasmaan Abbas
Hai Wafaon Ki Dastaan Abbas

1
Oss Ki Samjho Badal Gayi Qismat
Ho Gaye Jis Pe Meharbaan Abbas

2
Aaj Mehfil Mein Khoob Ronaq Hai
Jaisay Mojood Hoon Yahan Abbas

3
Hum Alam Iss Liye Uthatay Hain
Yeh Alam Hai Tera Nishaan Abbas

4
Har Taraf Bas Issi Ke Jalway Hain
Kiya Kahon Hain Kahan Kahan Abbas

5
Zairo Kiya Naseeb Paya Hai
Karbala Ke Hain Maizbaan Abbas

6
Tu Sahara Ali Ki Beti Ka
Qalb-e-Zahra Ali Ki Jaan Abbas

7
Likhe Zeeshan Our Nabeel Parhey
Chalta Jaye Yeh Karwaan Abbas

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check -- src/data/lyrics/hai-sakhawat-ka-aasmaan-abbas.md && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = 'src/data/lyrics/hai-sakhawat-ka-aasmaan-abbas.md'
current = Path(p).read_text()
_, yaml, body = current.split('---', 2)
roman = '\\n'.join(line.removeprefix('  ') for line in yaml.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].splitlines()).strip()
original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'HEAD:{p}'], text=True).split('---', 2)[2].strip()
assert roman.casefold() == original.casefold()
blocks = lambda s: [x.splitlines() for x in s.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
assert [len(x) for x in blocks(body)] == [len(x) for x in blocks(roman)] == [2]+[3]*7
assert [x[0] for x in blocks(body)[1:]] == list('۱۲۳۴۵۶۷')
print('Verified preserved Roman wording and matching stanza structure for 16 verses.')
PY"
